summary: Deliverable is incomplete: tests/__init__.py is empty (no unit tests), and workflow references undefined fixtures (fixtures/config.json, fixtures/oversized.json) and .actrc. Core matrix_generator.py is solid with validation but lacks type hints. Workflow's generate-matrix job conflates generation and oversized-config validation (should split into separate steps, ~13-34). run_act_tests.py test cases repeat expected_strings/absent_strings structure without abstraction, making new cases tedious.
